methodology.title: How the NFL model will work
methodology.body: Same two-layer architecture as the World Cup system: Layer 1 scores each game from team strength trajectories (an Elo-style rating updated weekly, rolling offensive/defensive form, rest days, home advantage) blended in a stacked ensemble; Layer 2 simulates the remaining season and playoff bracket thousands of times to produce title probabilities. Every prediction is logged to the tamper-evident public ledger before kickoff and graded against the closing Vegas line after each game — identical to the FIFA proof system.
